playbookOutputs: Completed Municipal Regulation R638 Certificate of Acceptability (CoA) Application Dossier
Customized R638 Food Hygiene SOP Pack (Cleaning, Cold Chain, Pest Control & Waste Management) & EHP Inspection Checklist
playbookCommonFailures: Premises lacks separate hand-washing basin with hot and cold running water in the food preparation area as required by Regulation R638
Person-in-Charge does not hold an accredited food safety / hygiene training certificate required by the local Environmental Health Practitioner (EHP)

informationToProvide.label: Business Premises Address & Municipality Name
informationToProvide.aiHint: Physical address of the food facility and which metro/local municipality has jurisdiction.

informationToProvide.label: Nature of Food Handling & Products
informationToProvide.aiHint: E.g., hot meal prep, bakery, butchery, retail pre-packaged, catering, or food delivery.

informationToProvide.label: Person-in-Charge Full Name & ID
informationToProvide.aiHint: The designated manager or person responsible for food hygiene on site.

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) & Certified ID Copy of Person-in-Charge (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate and certified ID copy of the designated Person-in-Charge.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 and certified ID of the designated food premises Person-in-Charge.

informationToProvide.label: Premises Layout / Floor Plan & Proof of Lawful Occupation (Lease Agreement or Municipal Account < 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload a sketch/floor plan showing food preparation, wash-up, storage, and toilet facilities, plus your signed lease or municipal bill.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Food premises floor layout sketch and proof of address / commercial lease agreement.

informationToProvide.label: Food Handler Hygiene Certificate, Pest Control Contract & Waste Removal Proof (If Already Available)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload any existing food safety training certificate, pest control contract, or trade waste agreement.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Food hygiene training certificate, pest control service report, or waste management documentation.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare municipal CoA application and hygiene checklist
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Municipal form completed with R638 readiness bundle

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver application pack to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Pack and inspector booking instructions delivered to client
